image_description: A vintage Panasonic boombox (stereo cassette player) sits on a carpeted floor. To the right of the boombox is a stack of five audio cassette tapes with handwritten labels (e.g., 'CATS & DOGS', 'RUNNING', 'EYE MOVIES'). The cassettes are stacked vertically, showing their spines and front faces. The boombox has dual speakers, a cassette deck in the center, and various control knobs and buttons.
